notes.title: 12.9 Improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing and sending us feedback. We fixed some bugs and added a few new features to make the game play more smooth and intuitive. Some of the fixes include:
- Added damage indicator
- after player dies, added option to go back to practice range
- fixed resolution issue with oculus
- updated giant enemy mechanics
- fixed enemy skeleton issues
- improved performance slightly by changing some of the post processing effects
- Improved health so player would regenerate after some time
